[SWS_CM_00067] Configuration of
IEEE1722TpAcfConnection.mixed-
BusTypeCollection
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00006, RS_CM_00004
⌈
If
IEEE1722TpAcfConnection.mixedBusTypeCollection
is set to false,
then each transmitted
IEEE1722TpAcfConnection
message shall have either
IEEE1722TpAcfCanPart
or
IEEE1722TpAcfLinPart
entries only.
⌋
